sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No supplied candidate is a verified canonical cross-owner path from the ship to tank-specific measurements and type; hasComponent only identifies the tank and does not provide the required paired measurement/type path.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the conditional logic to enforce the requirement for every applicable tank. The current FILTER NOT EXISTS for small capacities lets any capacity <=30 m³ globally exempt the ship, and the large-capacity block passes when any large-capacity/separation combination is adequate, rather than detecting each >30 m³ tank lacking separation >=0.76 m. Encode the >30 m³ exemption per tank/case and require a corresponding separation for every remaining tank, preserving the supplied ship owner and existing canonical terms.
